result.summary: Vardhit Auto Components has one open overdue invoice (INR 7.0m, 36 days past due, due 2026-10-18) against its sole TCI policy (TCI-WT-2026-0002, INR 60m limit), still unresolved. Prior four notifications over the last ~10 months all resolved quickly (3-6 days late), so this 36-day overdue marks a sharp escalation in severity even though notification frequency (2 in last 6 months vs 3 prior) hasn't increased. Total exposure (7m overdue + 19m not-yet-due = 26m) remains within the 60m limit, but the payment delay trend warrants closer monitoring.
concerns: Current overdue (36 DPD) is far longer than any prior resolved notification (max 6 days late), indicating a material change in payment behaviour
Single insurer/policy concentration (all notifications from TCI) limits visibility into broader buyer behaviour
Invoice remains unresolved as of the latest data, with no resolution date yet confirmed
